notes.title: May 2021 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Engine framework & optimisation updates
[*] Updated LobbyOne - Interactive playground plus hidden parkour
[*] New LobbyMap (LobbyTwo - Selectable in host menu)
[*] New Locomotion (movement/animation) system setup for Lobby Character - Pre Live Migration)
[*] Character customisation system for Lobby Character - (Pre Live Migration)
[/list]

[b]Engine framework & optimisation updates[/b]
We have updated the game engine framework to the latest stable release that will give the game more of a lease of life and more features we can add in the future, optimises have been made for the new lobby map and the old lobby map.

We have added a new selection to the main host menu so you can now select a lobby map, LobbyOne and LobbyTwo, check them out.

[b]Updated LobbyOne[/b]
We have been working hard on the lobby maps for this game, Lobby one now has an Interactive playground that you can walk around and walk on, don't forget the roundabout that you can spin just by walking around it, Why not try it with your friends standing on it and try spinning them! Not only the playground but we have added hidden parkour, you can just see it if you look hard enough and get to the platform at the top, it does not end there, you can get yourself 60% around LobbyOne if you find all the hidden blocks!

[b]New LobbyMap[/b]
LobbyTwo is the new Lobby map that you can select from the multiplayer host menu before you start a server and WOW have we got something special for you! this map is a city square with a mini football pitch and a few "beachball" sized footballs you can kick around lots of roads to tale a tour. there are also some buildings with scaffolding that you can climb up, there is so much more to come with this lobby in future small updates, you can try out the new Locomotion system by climbing on walls and alike.

[b]New Locomotion System[/b]
Some of you may ask what this means so I will tell you, Locomotion is the movement/animation system we have in the game, player movement, climbing, running, walking and a new emote system for ease of access the new emotes to have fun with your friends. Just hold E to see the new menu and new emotes.

This Loco System is being tried ONLY in the lobby, for now, to make sure everything is fine before we move it to the main hunter character for gameplay, please report all bugs on our bugs form or on the steam forums. 

[b]Character customisation system[/b]
The time has come to give you some customisation for the lobby character (again this is being trialled in the lobbies ONLY, for now, just Press 9 while in any of the lobbies to customise your character! don't forget to hit save though! and when you come back your character will be the same as you left it.

You can customise the look and the clothes of the character, more clothes will come in time if everything is working as it should.

All in all this has been a MAJOR update to the framework for the game and we can not wait to see what you all think of it!

Thank you for joining us on our very first indie game!
Chilltime Games!

notes.title: Server list bug fixed
notes.content: We found a bug in the server list that was not showing open severs, this has now been fixed and online servers will now be shown on the server browser page.

notes.title: Added Features and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello Hunters and Cloakers!

Today we bring you some new features... 

[b][u]Outline on objects[/u][/b]
when pointing at an object to cloak into it will now show you a nice yellow line around the object, Please be careful as not all objects are cloakable! 

[b][u]Name added[/u][/b]
The object name has now been added to the "Press E To Cloak".

[b][u]Level Sounds[/u][/b]
We have added in some ambient sounds to the levels but also some sounds that you can trigger when you get near them, please check them out!

[b][u]Added Freeze Mode[/u][/b]
We have now added a Freeze Mode to the Cloakers! if you jump and hit F you will freeze in place.

[b][u]UI Update[/u][/b]
UI update for Cloakers, We have now added the main controls on the screen so you are able to quickly see what controls you have to use.

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
We have now removed the sound and the blur when you press E to cloak into something you are unable to cloak into.

We have added some extra time for clients when entering the main game level so you all get 20 seconds to find something to cloak into.

notes.title: Early Acess Launch
notes.content:
Hunt N Cloak – “Early Access Release”
21:30PM Monday 15th March 2021

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729924/8ffbd8eab6cc81037811ca9baeb4189707fe1f1c.png[/img]

The long wait is finally over… it’s here for an Early Access release on Steam. Come and join in the fun and take part in the dedicated cloaker style game.

What’s it all about?
Hunt N Cloak is an online multiplayer game with a fantastic fun old skool element of "Hide & Seek".
Designed for Online Multiplayer up to 20 players, the fun element is amazing as you play either the Hunter (6 different characters to choose from) or the Cloaker where changing yourself is almost endless.
Set in a variety of environments including Outdoor desert, Internal Office, Vehicle Garage & Old Towns, you embark as either the Hunter or the Cloaker swapping roles after each round.

 
The Hunters - your role is to seek the Cloakers who could be hiding as one of many different environment objects, they could be a box... a barrel or even a coffin. When you find them, shoot them!

 
The Cloakers - your role is to stay hidden until the end of the round, you can switch objects as many times as you like by the press of a button, always cloaking into different objects to make it as hard as possible for the hunters to find you.
---------------------------------------------------
Why Early Access?
“Our goal is to develop a game that will be fun and enjoyable and take you back to the old skool classic "Hide & Seek" element. We've concentrated on the fun factor during our development to ensure the best playing experience possible... so you can enjoy some online multiplayer action in a fun and friendly community.”
Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“We are assuming that the Early Access phase will last several months. During this time, we will be listening to our players and community and developing further the required needs to establish an all-round fun, playable and enjoyable game. We will be adding new levels, features and implementing any great ideas that are offered in feedback. The customer is the heartbeat of our development and we intend to listen carefully to your views.”
How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“The full version of the game will offer many more features, including characters and a variety of levels set in different environments and scenarios. With a dedicated online multiplayer game, we will ensure that any content we develop will be done to the highest standards.”
What is the current state of the Early Access version?
“Hunt N Cloak currently offers:

- 6 Hunter Characters
- A large selection of cloakable objects (props)
- 4 Levels which are fully playable.”
Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
“To keep things simple... Yes, we would like to appreciate and thank all those who decide to help us improve on our existing format, so the price will be lower for the entire period of early access. Once all the initial features have been implemented and tweaked, the price will be raised but only slightly as we want to provide a fun and affordable product.”
How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
“We will read all suggestions and gather all community feedback. We will focus on the feedback that supports the core game idea and will be practical from development point. Players will be able to provide us valuable feedback in a simple way - We have Bugs and Feedback topics on steam forums, and we have dedicated channels on our discord server where you can leave your opinion or report a bug.
All new ideas and feedbacks are important to us because we want to improve our game as much as possible. Community hub on Steam is a very good channel to reach us, but players can contact us on our discord server (https://discord.gg/r6vRQBC).”

---------------------------------------------------
We look forward to seeing you all hosting and joining a “Game Server” and participating with the HnC community in “Discord”
